reason: Small, well-contained fix to taxonomy pagination logic (adds proper Skip/Take and null checks) that changes previous behavior of over-fetching one extra item without offset, which could subtly affect any code relying on the old off-by-one/no-skip behavior but is otherwise low-risk and localized.
